results.name: alberta-municipal-officials-directory
results.notes: Contains up-to-date contact information on municipal officials for Alberta municipalities, special areas, Metis settlements, regional services commissions, local government associations, and other organizations. The  website offers the option to search for contact information search by name, official type, local authority name, and local authority type, as well as the ability to download the complete listing into a spreadsheet.
results.title: Alberta municipal officials directory
results.usage:
The information reflects the latest contact information for municipal officials as provided by Alberta municipalities, Special Areas, Metis Settlements, regional services commissions, local government associations, and other organizations to Alberta Municipal Affairs.  

As the information is provided to Alberta Municipal Affairs from these outside sources, the information is subject to reporting errors beyond the control of the department.

results.name: list-of-albertas-school-jurisdiction-schools-with-their-total-capacity-for-the-school-year
results.notes: This dataset presents information on capacity and utilization rates for school facilities in Alberta's K-12 public educational system. Student enrolment numbers are submitted by public school jurisdictions to Alberta Education each year. Alberta Education calculates the adjusted enrolment and utilization rate for each school facility to account for the additional space needs required by some students.
